ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central peduncle and perimeter. Two distinct high-intensity (white) horizontal bands occupy the mid-section of the left and right lobes, containing internal low-intensity mottling and vertical linear disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:6 relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary featuring continuous small-scale serrations; distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular clusters of pixels indicative of heavy encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast light clusters (likely barnacles) scattered across the dark central and peripheral regions; smaller dark circular focal spots visible within the white lobe patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of vertical, parallel low-intensity lines (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe; secondary shorter linear marks on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular protrusions and bio-fouling on both distal tips; visible trailing skin filament or debris hanging from the left trailing edge approximately 20% inward from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-brown chromatic staining (diatom accumulation) localized in the centers of the high-intensity white patches on both lobes.
